The format of the chapter -- a heartfelt LETTER, against a story, a news report or a paper. C-2.1-LO-15's first clause, identifying the form of the text.
Who the letter is addressed to (her daughter Ming) -- recall, C-2.2 competency.
What Ming expressed -- big ambitions together with doubts. Recall of the premise, C-2.2 competency.
The mother as a GUIDING LIGHT -- a metaphor, and the distractors (shining, glowing, blazing) are all light words, so what is tested is the figure rather than the fact. C-2.2-LO-36.
The two things she balances -- encouragement and reality. The structure of her argument, C-2.2-LO-38. LO-36 names antithesis, but the item asks what she balances, not that she uses a figure.
Which phrase she opens with ('Follow that great dream') -- recall of a line, C-2.2 competency.
The mother acts like a wise and caring TEACHER -- characterisation recall, C-2.2 competency. Not LO-36: the comparison is the item's own wording, not a figure the text asks to be analysed.
What she wants Ming to understand about the road ahead (it is tough) -- the caution half of the case, C-2.2-LO-38.
How Ming feels about the path (deep doubts and fears) -- recall, C-2.2 competency.
